videos.title: Why the Iran War Is So Important to Trump’s Midterms | WSJ
videos.description:
GREAT NECK, N.Y.—Most Americans—including many Iranian Americans and Jewish Americans—oppose the war in Iran. But a thriving community of Persian Jews on Long Island are some of the war’s most ardent defenders.

WSJ's Michelle Hackman returned home to Long Island to find out how the war in Iran is affecting her community and the midterm elections.

videos.title: Why Gen Z Men Are Rethinking Their 2024 Trump Vote | WSJ
videos.description:
President Trump was ushered into a second term in office in part by winning over young men, a majority of whom supported him. Two years later, that support has eroded.

Republicans are on the defense heading into the November elections as they grapple with Trump’s low approval ratings with young men and other parts of his 2024 coalition. Democrats are heavily favored to win the House and have a chance at retaking the Senate, according to analysts.

Last year, The Wall Street Journal brought together a group of men under 30 years old who had all voted for Trump to get their grades of his first six months in office. We invited them back just before the 2026 midterm elections to get their perspectives.
